5:- Spec build: building the spec ahead of it, and after it for a spec step

content.text:
Queued time is no longer part of the Time chart. The bar, legend shares and timeline now start when the task was sent from the queue, so they cover only the time it was actually running.

The wait itself shows as one muted line under the timeline, such as "Queued 2:14 before it started", and is left out if the task never waited. For a chain, that line adds up every step's queue wait.

Removing Queued leaves eight kinds, and each keeps the chart colour it had, so Other is still the grey. I updated the time-breakdown tests for this, and they pass with a clean build.

The spec and your prompt agree here.
